profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | React.js | Node.js | JavaScript (ES6+) | Redux-toolkit | React Hooks | HTML5 | Tailwind CSS | Angular | Java | Spring Boot | REST APIs | UI Developer | Looking for New Opportunities
profile.summary:
• Full Stack Developer with 9+ years of experience  in designing and developing scalable, user-friendly, responsive web applications using  HTML, Tailwind CSS, React.js, Angular and Java.
• Expertise understanding of React fundamentals, hooks, component lifecycle, and state management 
• Experienced in designing, building and consuming RESTful APIs with secure and scalable integration for real-time problems.
• Experienced in solving complex problems, optimizing performance, and creating seamless user experiences. Always eager to learn, adapt, and push the boundaries of frontend development.
 • Skills: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, React.js, React Hooks, Redux, React Router, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, MongoDB, MySQL

positions.title: Full Stack Developer (Angular)
positions.description:
● Designed and developed scalable Single Page Applications using React.js and Angular 11 for payment processing
systems
● Built backend microservices using Java 11, Spring Boot, and REST APIs to support high-volume transaction
processing
● Implemented secure payment gateway integrations with tokenization and PCI-DSS compliance standards
● Developed reusable UI components with responsive layouts using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
● Integrated frontend applications with backend services using REST APIs and asynchronous programming patterns
● Optimized application performance by implementing lazy loading, code splitting, and caching strategies
● Collaborated in Agile environment with sprint planning, daily standups, and code reviews
● Worked on debugging, enhancements, and production issue fixes for critical payment systems
● Mentored junior developers on best practices for full stack development and code quality

positions.title: Java React Full Stack
positions.description:
• Strengthened frontend development skills by working with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI practices 
• Built small-scale web applications and reusable UI components using React.js (functional components, hooks basics) 
• Worked on independent/freelance-style projects, focusing on UI enhancements, bug fixing, and performance improvements 
• Gained practical exposure to integrating frontend applications with backend systems using REST APIs and JSON-based data handling 
• Practiced building and testing APIs using Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js for better full stack understanding 
• Explored microservices architecture concepts, including service communication and modular design 
• Improved problem-solving skills through coding practice and revisiting Data Structures & Algorithms fundamentals 
• Focused on writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code following industry best practices 
• Stayed updated with latest trends in frontend and full stack development through documentation and hands-on learning
Skills: React.js (Basics), JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, JSON, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with CVS Specialty which is offered by CVS Health that focuses on providing medications and support for patients with complex, chronic, or rare conditions.
• Designed, developed scalable UI components with responsive layouts using Angular 11, modern JavaScript concepts, HTML5, CSS3, and PrimeNG 
 • Integrated frontend with backend services using REST APIs and asynchronous programming (AJAX) 
 • Developed micro-services using Java 11 and Spring Boot following microservices architecture 
 • Developed and consumed APIs using Node.js and TypeScript 
 • Implemented reusable UI components and improved application performance 
 • Implemented interceptors and handled API request/response lifecycle 
 • Worked on cross-browser compatibility and performance optimization 
 • Collaborated in Agile environment with sprint planning and code reviews 
•  Worked on debugging, enhancements, and production issue fixes
• Implemented features like pagination, sorting, filtering, and reusable components 
• Integrated frontend with backend using REST APIs and HTTP services 
• Developed APIs and middleware using Node.js 
• Wrote unit test cases using Jasmine, Karma, and JUnit 
• Improved UI performance and optimized API calls 
• Implemented validation, error handling, and user-friendly UI interactions 
• Participated in Agile ceremonies and collaborated with cross-functional teams 
• Worked on enhancing existing modules and fixing production issues

positions.title: Java Front End Developer
positions.description:
Worked on application for internal use to build widgets for advocates who are answering the questions of clients.
• Developed UI widgets using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery 
• Built responsive layouts and interactive components 
• Implemented form validations and user input handling 
• Worked on AngularJS-based SPA modules 
• Integrated APIs using HTTP services 
• Fixed cross-browser compatibility issues 
• Improved UI performance and usability
